name: Ming-Image-0.1-Design (text-to-image) and Design-Layer (layer decomposition)
purpose: Open-source series for visual-design generation: Design generates complete UI, infographic, poster and other text-rich compositions, with RGBA (transparent background) output; Design-Layer decomposes a flattened design image into a requested number of editable RGBA layers (cards).

license.name: MIT
license.notes: LICENSE of inclusionAI/Ming-Image-0.1-Design read: MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026 inclusionAI. Design-Layer states MIT in its card metadata (its LICENSE file not opened).

architecture.kind: MLLM (BailingMoeV2 MoE, 20 layers, 256 experts, 8 active, hidden 2048) plus connector plus diffusion transformer (sampled in 12 steps, CFG 1.0); series described as two 6B-parameter models (README of the code repository)

variants.format: safetensors BF16 (mllm 34 GB, DiT 13.3 GB, connector 6.2 GB)
variants.notes: validated: one CUDA GPU with 80 GiB VRAM in BF16 (README); the 6B figure does not match the repo size, the card does not explain how it counts parameters
layer decomposition, 12 steps, CFG 2.0, 1024 working bucket recommended
components: mllm 11.6, DiT 6.67, connector 1.86, VAE 0.25 GB
repo total from the HF API; which quantizations it holds was not read
repo total from the HF API, not read further

pc-12gb.notes: smallest quantization found is 8.44 GB for the whole repo, which holds an unknown number of files; no quality or speed data for any quantization

pc-16gb.notes: unverified: depends on what the GGUF files contain

pc-32gb.variant: quantized, with RAM offload of the MoE language model

mac-16-24gb.notes: MLX 4bit 20.5 GB against about 12 GB GPU share

mac-32gb.notes: 20.5 GB against about 22 GB GPU share

strengths: Aimed at text-rich design output (UI, posters, infographics) and transparent-background RGBA output
Layer variant produces editable layers; the vendor ships agent skills (UI design, image to editable PPT)
weaknesses: Vendor-validated hardware is a single 80 GiB GPU
Works best with a structured Figma-style JSON prompt produced by a separate prompt enhancer (Ling-3.0-flash-VL or qwen3.8-27B)
soft.maturity: inclusionAI; version 0.1; many community quantizations and ports within weeks of release.

tona_fit.reason: MIT-licensed and the only open model aimed at UI and design output with transparency and layers, which suits a coding-agent worker that checks UI visually, but the vendor-validated hardware is 80 GiB and the largest part is a 34 GB MoE language model; no quality or speed data for the small quantizations. Reconsider when a 16 GB-class quantization has a measured quality check.
blockers: no measured quality or speed on consumer GPUs
needs a separate prompt-enhancer LLM for best results

sources.note: series description, sampling defaults, 80 GiB validated deployment, prompt enhancer
